title: Wilder Wild Bushy Leaves
description: This resource pack adds bushy leaves to wilderwilds.
body: Note that this resource pack does not include bushy leaves for vanilla leaves, so that you can still use your regular bushy leaves underneath (I see you Laynce...). If you are looking for a regular bushy leaves resource pack I would recommend: [WhyJan's Better Foliage](https://modrinth.com/resourcepack/whyjans-better-foliage/versions)
